answer: Audits are recorded in thread, queued in vine, and tide publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 33 identities per epoch. A farm of 172 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 1119 identities would post 2473 proofs and burn roughly 52 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
